reasoning: On the season so far the Suns are the stronger team; with home court the Suns start about 12 points better, in a game of about 229 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 2 points towards the Kings.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Suns win 77 times in 100, by about 10; most games like this end between 202 and 251 total points.
